# AGENTS.md — 10-yoga-wellness

Instructions for AI coding agents working in this folder.

## Context
- Template: **Hold Studio**, yoga & wellness, style "1960s exercise booklet".
- Stack: Astro 7, Tailwind CSS 4. Do not add dependencies unless the user asks.
- The design contract is in `DESIGN.md`. Read it before changing anything visual.

## Files
- `src/content.ts` — poses (joint coordinates), breath phases, timetable, teachers, all copy (EN + RU)
- `src/pages/index.astro` — page markup + client script (morph, breath, filter)
- `src/styles/global.css` — tokens in Tailwind `@theme` + diagram styles
- `src/components/T.astro` — bilingual text helper

## How to run
- `npm install          # Node 22.23+ (Astro 7)`
- `npm run dev`
- `npm run build   # ./dist`

## Rules
- Content changes go to the content file, not into markup or components.
- Every user-facing string exists in **en** and **ru**. English is the default; `?lang=ru` and the language button switch it.
- Colors, fonts, radii and spacing are tokens. Change tokens, not individual elements.
- Keep the signature block: Stick-figure pose diagram that morphs between six poses + a 4-4-6 breath counter.
- Keep accessibility: semantic headings, visible focus, alt text, `prefers-reduced-motion` support, body text contrast ≥ 4.5:1.
- Keep it static: no backend, no booking or payment flows.
- No photos of people — poses are joint coordinates drawn as diagrams.
- One ink (navy) + one spot colour (mustard). No sage green, no soft blobs.
- Condensed caps for headings and labels, a bookish serif for reading.
- Every section is numbered like a booklet chapter.
- Motion only explains: the figure morphs, the breath disc grows and shrinks.

## Done means
- The page builds/opens without console errors.
- Both languages render with no missing strings.
- Layout works from 360 px to 1920 px wide.
